html:
Ecommerce Website Launch $2,950

You can launch a new website for $2,950. The package includes up to five pages, a unique design, contact forms and basic SEO, and you own the code, content and domain.

What’s included

  • Launch fee: $2,950
  • Pages: up to 5
  • Design: custom layout for each page
  • Features: contact forms, basic SEO settings
  • Hosting: $0 /month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub
  • Ownership: you keep all code, content and the domain
  • Support: 90 days of free care after launch
  • Deposit: 50 % up front, balance due at launch

How the process works

  1. Free homepage remake – Send us your current site or a design idea. We build a new homepage at no cost. If you don’t like it, you keep the design.
  2. Design & build – We create a custom design for up to five pages, add contact forms and set up basic SEO.
  3. Launch – We publish the site on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub, typically within about a week.
  4. Post‑launch care – You receive 90 days of free support. After that you can choose a care plan for $295 /month or $595 /month and cancel anytime.

Who this works for

  • Small businesses that need a professional online presence
  • Nonprofits looking for a cost‑effective site
  • Founders and individuals launching a new brand or service
  • Projects that benefit from a remote‑first studio

All clients receive the same ownership rights and hosting arrangement, regardless of location. We reply within one business day.

FAQ

Do I need to provide content? You can supply text, images and any product data you have. We can also help source assets if needed.

What happens after the 90 days of free care? You may continue with a care plan at $295 /month or $595 /month, or you can end support at any time.

Is the site ready to use right after launch? Yes. The site is live on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub, and you have full control of the domain and code.

Next step

Ready to start your website launch? Visit our contact page and fill out the brief form. We’ll get back to you within one business day to begin the free homepage remake.
